screening_decisions.reason: RCT comparing a tablet-based education/information system plus weight scale versus standard HF information. The tablet delivers health education per guidelines, meeting the mHealth education intervention criterion.
RCT evaluating a web-based education website (heartfailurematters.org) versus usual care. The website is an internet-based education programme, fitting the selection criteria.

RCT comparing SMS follow-up (a mobile-based communication) with telephone and regular follow-up. SMS follow-up likely includes educational content; it fits the mHealth-delivered education definition.

This study is an economic model derived from a meta-analysis, not a randomized controlled trial; it does not constitute primary research on mHealth education.
